_note: 程式研究區 — research that feeds MSSP's next versions rather than documenting
its current one. Sources are Word documents converted with pandoc; the
converted Markdown lives in research/sources/ and is what gets published.
The four entries map onto the four directions Neo identified for MSSP:
AI management, folder language, architecture visualisation (legible to AI as
well as to people), and dynamic/scale-aware MSSP.
`name_status: provisional` means the work has no settled formal name yet and
the title shown is a working one.

direction_note.zh: 這四篇對應 MSSP 接下來的四個方向：AI 管理、資料夾語言、架構可視化（人與 AI 都看得懂），以及動態／規模感知的 MSSP。它們不是 MSSP 現況的說明，是它下一批版本的材料。
direction_note.en: These four map onto the four directions MSSP is heading: AI management, a folder language, architecture visualisation legible to people and to AI alike, and a dynamic, scale-aware MSSP. They describe where the method is going, not where it currently is.

title.zh: 資料夾程式語言：從認知架構到可執行規範
title.en: Folder Programming Language: from cognitive architecture to executable specification

summary.zh: 把資料夾結構從「放檔案的容器」提升為語言本身的本體：目錄即宣告，路徑即語義，架構不再是描述程式的文件，而是可以被執行的規範。
summary.en: Raises folder structure from a container that holds files into an entity of the language itself: a directory is a declaration and a path carries meaning, so architecture stops being a document about the program and becomes a specification that runs.

name_note.zh: 正式名稱尚未定案，FPL 是目前的工作名。
name_note.en: The formal name is not settled; FPL is the working title.

title.zh: GitHub 架構透視器：讓隱藏的架構可視化
title.en: GitHub Architecture Scope: making hidden architecture visible

summary.zh: 一個倉庫的真實架構藏在 import 圖、目錄慣例與變更歷史裡，讀 README 看不到。這篇提出把它直接畫出來，並且畫成人與 AI 都能消費的形式。
summary.en: A repository's real architecture hides in its import graph, directory conventions, and change history — none of which a README shows. This proposes drawing it directly, in a form both a person and an agent can consume.

title.zh: 軟體專案的規模感知架構組織範式
title.en: Scale-Aware Architecture Organisation for Software Projects

summary.zh: 從認知負荷、圖論與組織理論推導出「多大的專案該用多少結構」，並讓這個判斷隨專案成長自動演化，而不是在第一天就凍結一套模板。
summary.en: Derives how much structure a project of a given size should carry, from cognitive load, graph theory, and organisational theory — and lets that judgement evolve as the project grows instead of freezing a template on day one.

relates_to.zh: 直接對應 MSSP 手冊裡的「度」，並把它從一張表格推進成可推導的模型。
relates_to.en: Directly extends the field manual's notion of the right amount, pushing it from a table into a derivable model.

title.zh: AI 驅動的靜態記憶體邊界推斷系統

summary.zh: 在 MSSP 的模組邊界之上做後驗式靜態推斷：讓 AI 推出每個模組的記憶體上界，取代動態管理的不可預測與傳統靜態分析的過度保守。
summary.en: Posterior static inference on top of MSSP's module boundaries: an AI derives a memory upper bound per module, replacing both the unpredictability of dynamic management and the over-conservatism of classical static analysis.

relates_to.zh: 唯一一篇直接建立在 MSSP 架構之上的研究——模組邊界是它的推斷單位。
relates_to.en: The only one of the four built directly on MSSP: its module boundaries are the unit the inference works over.
